mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% for two consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, which raises discount rates and reduces present value of future corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 70% of triggered episodes, or the mechanism fails when inflation exceeds 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) of more than 2% coincident with a housing starts (HOUST) drop of more than 15% in the prior quarter signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY change < -2% AND HOUST QoQ change < -15%
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the mechanism does not activate during NBER-defined recessions.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% for three consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressure and input costs, compressing profit margins and resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes, or the mechanism fails when inflation exceeds 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) of more than 0.5% for four consecutive months signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate earnings visibility and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO monthly change < -0.5% for 4 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in both the federal funds rate and the Consumer Price Index above their respective 5-year averages signals a dual tightening of monetary and inflationary pressures, which increases real discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent monthly increase in real personal savings (RSAFS) above its 10-year average while personal income (PAYEMS) growth lags behind GDP growth signals elevated precautionary savings, which reduces consumer spending and corporate revenue, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS > 10-year avg AND PAYEMS growth < GDPC1 growth for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate of more than 0.4 percentage points from the prior month during a period when the federal funds rate is below 2% signals deteriorating labor market conditions in a low-rate environment, which depresses consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 50% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in housing starts (HOUST) of more than 10% from the prior year while GDP growth remains positive signals a housing market correction without broader economic downturn, which reduces construction-related equity revenues and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST < prior year -10% AND GDPC1 growth > 0%
regime_hint: housing market correction with positive GDP growth
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 50% of triggered episodes.
